name: Kuuhaku Kitan ~Namanaru Soumatou~
original_name: 空白奇譚〜生なる走馬燈〜
source:
The protagonist had a boring day until he found a book in an old bookstore he dropped in. When he was worried about the content and turned the page, the protagonist lost consciousness on the spot... and the destination he woke up...

[Edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230510201842/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.blank]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
原本百无聊赖度日的主角，在顺路光顾的一家旧书店里发现了一本书。他好奇书中内容并翻开书页的瞬间，竟当场失去了意识……而当他再度醒来时，身处的地方却是……

[整编自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230510201842/https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.interest.blank]Google Play[/url]]
